public_rationale: The ordinary reading concerns financial sustainability. OpenAI has publicly described a commercial strategy, so absence of any plan would be too strong a reading. But a stated strategy does not demonstrate sustainable economics. Neither current losses nor outside fundraising settles the broader claim about both companies.
limitations: The assessment depends on interpreting “worked out” as financially sustainable.
Public disclosures do not reveal every operating assumption or financing option.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Neither OpenAI nor Anthropic has worked out its business model.

statement.excerpt: Let’s also be blunt about something: neither OpenAI nor Anthropic have worked out their business models.

from_speaker: have worked out their business models
our_interpretation: The surrounding discussion makes financial sustainability the ordinary reading: neither company has established a credible way to cover its continuing costs without repeated outside funding.
Having subscriptions, customers, or a monetization plan alone does not establish financial sustainability. Conversely, current losses alone do not establish that a business model cannot work.
Use April–June 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before publication, as the reference period for this ongoing observation.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence about both companies establishes that their existing commercial arrangements and reasonably supported operating plans cannot cover continuing costs without repeated outside funding.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one company has demonstrated sustainable economics or a sufficiently substantiated operating plan that covers continuing costs without repeated outside funding.
